title: Private Console: onboarding checklist + connectivity simulator & upgrade-impact preview
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: design an operator-friendly onboarding checklist and interactive connectivity simulator for Private/VPC clusters, plus an Upgrade Impact Preview (cost/latency/rollback) to reduce upgrade anxiety for SREs and platform engineers. This ticket covers low-fidelity -> high-fidelity prototypes, accessibility pass, and design handoff artifacts for engineering and PM reviews. The aim is to combine cluster health status, network checks, and an upgrade cost/latency delta slider into a single Compact Cluster Panel view that fits inside the Private Console Cluster detail page.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist UI: shows mandatory network checks, KMS integration status, and node readiness with clear next steps
Connectivity Simulator: interactive module that simulates cross-subnet traffic and shows expected egress/latency and failed paths
Upgrade Impact Preview: slider to preview upgrade candidate (runtime+kernel) with cost delta and estimated p95 latency change
Rollback Action: clearly visible emergency rollback CTA with required confirmations and audit log link
Design Handoff: Figma file, tokens, and CSS specs + a clear list of API contracts for ENG (network test endpoints)
tasks: Sketch flows for onboarding checklist and compact cluster panel (Aisha)

designers_notes: Key UX decisions: 1) Use a single-row compact panel with progressive disclosure to keep cluster detail page scannable. 2) Connectivity simulator runs in 'sandbox' mode by default and shows simulated path heatmaps. 3) Upgrade preview shows 3 scenarios (Conservative, Typical, Aggressive) with cost delta and p95 latency estimate; engineer can 'simulate' to request a dry-run. 4) Emphasize safe defaults: automated checks should not run destructive actions without explicit opt-in.
decision_log: 2025-02-20: Chose compact panel over full-page walkthrough to reduce context switching (Design + PM)
2025-02-25: Use sandboxed simulated connectivity by default; allow explicit live-check with elevated permissions (Eng)
2025-03-03: Upgrade cost deltas will be estimates derived from historical token throughput and instance pricing (Product)
2025-03-04: Security review required before shipping connectivity test; flagged as blocker for release (Security)
